prompts.name: ydp_outpaint1
prompts.prompt: Image 1 is a street photo placed in the middle of a flat gray canvas. Replace ONLY the flat gray areas (left strip, right strip, top strip and the bottom area) by naturally continuing the same real street scene outward: more autumn trees, the construction fence and buildings on the sides, and the sidewalk pavement and people's legs/feet continuing downward at the bottom. Match the lighting, colors, perspective and photo grain so it looks like one single original photograph. Do NOT change anything inside the existing photo: same man, same sign with identical Korean text, same people, same faces. No new text, no logo, no watermark.
